title: What If You Stood at the Bottom of the Deepest Hole Ever Drilled?

scenes.text: What if you stood at the bottom of the deepest hole ever drilled? It's hotter than scientists expected.
Russia's Kola Superdeep Borehole reached 12,262 meters, about seven and a half miles, but it's only nine inches wide.
Scientists expected about 100 degrees Celsius down there. They measured about 180.
The rock behaved more like plastic than solid, so the hole kept trying to flow shut.
At around eight kilometers the granite was cracked and soaked in water, and hydrogen gas pushed boiling mud up the hole.
After about twenty-four years the drill stopped, still short of its goal. Earth's crust is far thicker.

description:
What if you stood at the bottom of the deepest hole ever drilled?
The Kola Superdeep Borehole reached 12,262 meters and found rock far hotter than expected, as hot as 180 degrees Celsius.
